newsitem.title: RWANDA: Nyerere discusses Burundi crisis in Rwanda.
newsitem.headline: Nyerere discusses Burundi crisis in Rwanda.

text.p: The international mediator on Burundi Julius Nyerere left Rwanda on Thursday after talks with Rwandan leaders on sanctions against Burundi, state-run radio said.
It said Nyerere, a former Tanzanian president, left Kigali for the northern Tanzania town of Arusha, where a committee set up by regional leaders to monitor sanctions is due to meet on Friday.

Nyerere this week has also visited Uganda and Kenya, where he told reporters on Wednesday that both the Tutsi-dominated army and Hutu rebels in Burundi would be making a terrible mistake in trying to resolve the country's crisis militarily.

Regional leaders clamped sanctions on landlocked Burundi on July 31 to pressure its Tutsi military ruler Pierre Buyoya, who seized power in an army coup on July 25, to agree to peace talks with the Hutu rebels and a return to constitutional rule.
